[EXPERIMENTAL] Show a change request's events.

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Show a change request's events

This command shows a change request's events, such as new revisions, approvals, comments, and
status changes.


```
pulumi env change-request log <change-request-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Show a change request's events
  pulumi env change-request log <change-request-id>

  # Show a change request's events as JSON
  pulumi env change-request log <change-request-id> --output json
```
